label: Kinetic Text
description: Editorial text line with the two sanctioned entrances. Default: house line-rise (whole line rises ~10px, fades in ~300ms). entrance:'type-on': words appear in place in reading order on a beat interval and the centered line reflows as it grows (tempo-cut build-up). No per-word effects in either mode. Emphasis via *stars* = brand-color accent, color only.

text.label: Text. Wrap key words in *stars* to accent them in brand color.

color.label: Text color override (CSS color). Default is the brand text color -- on dark scenes set an explicit light color, e.g. #f5f6fa.

entrance.label: rise (default, whole-line house entrance) | type-on (word-by-word build-up with live reflow)

at.label: type-on only: when the first word lands (default 0.3)

word_interval.label: type-on only: seconds between words (default 0.14). Set to the beat subdivision to cut on music.

word_times.label: type-on only: explicit per-word times in seconds (overrides word_interval; e.g. beat-grid times)

font_size.label: Override size (CSS, e.g. '16vw' for a hero numeral; default 60px)
